title: 互連電遷移可靠度
summary: 從電子流與原子遷移、加速模型到使用情境：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Electron flow and atomic transport and Acceleration model to Use-condition transfer: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 電子流與原子遷移 → 通孔擁擠
stages.titleEn: Electron flow and atomic transport to Via current crowding
stages.description: 把「電子流與原子遷移」「電流密度」「通孔擁擠」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Electron flow and atomic transport, Current density, Via current crowding.

steps.title: 電子流與原子遷移：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Electron flow and atomic transport: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「原子通量與通量散度不是同一量」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities.
steps.instruction: 畫導線的電子流、傳統電流及可能原子通量，分清方向定義。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw electron flow, conventional current and possible atomic flux with explicit conventions. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 原子通量與通量散度不是同一量；通量散度對應局部堆積與耗空。
steps.observationEn: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities; Flux divergence tracks accumulation or depletion.
steps.failure: 若採用「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Locating every void from a current arrow alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「電子流與原子遷移」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：原子通量與通量散度不是同一量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Electron flow and atomic transport diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities.

knowledge.titleEn: Electron flow and atomic transport / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Locating every void from a current arrow alone.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「互連電遷移可靠度」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「電子流與原子遷移：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：平均電流密度不能描述通孔擁擠與局部溫升。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「互連救援：填孔、平坦化與可靠度」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：互連電遷移可靠度 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「平均電流密度不能描述通孔擁擠與局部溫升」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Interconnect electromigration reliability as the task boundary. After reading “Electron flow and atomic transport: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Mean current density does not describe via crowding and local heating. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Interconnect rescue: fill, planarization and reliability”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Interconnect electromigration reliability: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Mean current density does not describe via crowding and local heating” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「電子流與原子遷移」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Electron flow and atomic transport, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 原子通量與通量散度不是同一量
只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置
用額定電流直接比較不同線寬壽命
optionsEn: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities
Locating every void from a current arrow alone
Comparing different widths by rated current alone
quiz.explanation: 原子通量與通量散度不是同一量；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 電子流與原子遷移：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electron flow and atomic transport: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Locating every void from a current arrow alone.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「電子流與原子遷移」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：通量散度對應局部堆積與耗空。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Electron flow and atomic transport artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Locating every void from a current arrow alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Flux divergence tracks accumulation or depletion. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 原子通量與通量散度不是同一量；通量散度對應局部堆積與耗空。
steps.observationEn: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities; Flux divergence tracks accumulation or depletion.
steps.failure: 若採用「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Locating every void from a current arrow alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「電子流與原子遷移」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「通量散度對應局部堆積與耗空」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Electron flow and atomic transport, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Flux divergence tracks accumulation or depletion" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 電子流與原子遷移／物理與模型

knowledge.title: 電子流與原子遷移／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Electron flow and atomic transport / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」與「原子通量與通量散度不是同一量」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

steps.title: 電流密度：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「相同電流不代表相同電流密度」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Equal current does not imply equal current density.
steps.instruction:
對兩種截面計算 J=I/A，並分別記錄總電流與截面。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設矩形互連寬 100 nm、厚 50 nm，電流 1 mA，均勻截面 A=5×10⁻¹⁵ m²；J=I/A=2×10¹¹ A/m²=2×10⁷ A/cm²，即 20 MA/cm²。再把厚度改為 40 nm，J 升為 25 MA/cm²。此例只練習單位與幾何敏感度，不是允許電流或可靠度門檻，也忽略局部電流擁擠。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate J=I/A for two cross-sections while recording current and area separately. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a rectangular line 100 nm wide and 50 nm thick carrying 1 mA uniformly. A=5×10⁻¹⁵ m²; J=I/A=2×10¹¹ A/m²=2×10⁷ A/cm², or 20 MA/cm². At 40 nm thickness J becomes 25 MA/cm². This exercises units and geometry sensitivity, not permitted current or a reliability limit; it ignores local current crowding.
steps.observation: 相同電流不代表相同電流密度；膜厚誤差直接傳到電流密度。
steps.observationEn: Equal current does not imply equal current density; Thickness error propagates into current density.
steps.failure: 若採用「用額定電流直接比較不同線寬壽命」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Comparing different widths by rated current alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「電流密度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：相同電流不代表相同電流密度。
算例驗收：驗算 20 與 25 MA/cm²，註明 A/m² 轉 A/cm² 要除以 10,000。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Current density diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal current does not imply equal current density.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 20 and 25 MA/cm², noting that A/m² converts to A/cm² by division by 10,000.

knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Parallel vias need not share current equally.

knowledge.title: 通孔擁擠／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Via current crowding / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把整段均勻 J 當成通孔最壞值」與「平均 J 可能低估局部應力」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Using uniform line J as the worst via value" is not equivalent to "Average J can underestimate local stress"; the control must expose their difference.

quiz.question: 檢查「通孔擁擠」時，哪個新增因素應納入？
quiz.questionEn: Which additional factor belongs in a check of Via current crowding?
options: 把整段均勻 J 當成通孔最壞值
以載台設定值取代導線實際溫度
平行通孔不一定平均分流
optionsEn: Using uniform line J as the worst via value
Replacing conductor temperature with the chuck setpoint
Parallel vias need not share current equally
quiz.explanation: 平行通孔不一定平均分流；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Parallel vias need not share current equally. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.
